items.summary: Biocon has finalized a global settlement and license agreement with Genentech for its drug Pebrilzo. This agreement addresses all ongoing legal disputes between the two companies in jurisdictions such as the US and Canada. Under the terms, Biocon can launch Pebrilzo in the EU and UK by early 2027 and in the US by Q3 of 2028. Other global launches are planned between 2026 and 2028, depending on regulatory approvals.

items.summary:
State-owned Canara Bank on Wednesday reported an 8 per cent increase in net profit at Rs 5,175 crore for the September quarter of this fiscal.
During the same quarter of the previous financial year, the bank had earned a net profit of Rs 4,774 crore in the year-ago period.
Total income increased to Rs 40,931 crore in the second quarter from Rs 38,598 crore in the same period of the previous fiscal year, Canara Bank said in a regulatory filing.
Interest income improved to Rs 35,159 crore from Rs 31,544 crore in the same quarter a year ago.
Net Interest Income witnessed a 20 per cent jump in the reported quarter to Rs 11,005 crore as against Rs 9,141 crore a year ago.
Operating profit also increased to Rs 8,758 crore as against Rs 8,588 crore in the same quarter a year ago.
In terms of asset quality, gross non-performing assets (NPAs) of the bank moderated to 1.33 per cent of gross advances at the end of September 2026 as against 2.35 per cent by the year-ago period.
